step1_figure.description: A folded-cascode operational amplifier utilizing gain-enhancement (GE) techniques to boost low-frequency open-loop gain. The netlist is configured as a unity-gain buffer with 240fF GE compensation capacitors, matching the simulation setup described for Figure 24.53.

GE_diff_amp_gain.description: Gain of the auxiliary differential amplifiers used for gain enhancement.

equation.explanation: The gain is the transconductance of the input pair multiplied by the output resistance.
equation.assumptions: Assumes simple differential amplifier topology for the GE stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming typical bias Id=10uA, W/L=10: gmp ≈ 100uS, ro ≈ 1MOhm. AP = 100uS * (1MOhm || 1MOhm) = 100uS * 500kOhm = 50 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical SKY130 PMOS transconductance and output resistance at moderate inversion.

open_loop_gain_GE.description: Total low-frequency open-loop gain of the op-amp with gain enhancement.

equation.explanation: The intrinsic open-loop gain is multiplied by the gain of the GE amplifier.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the GE amplifier effectively regulates the cascode drain without introducing dominant low-frequency poles.

sky130_expected.calculation: Intrinsic folded cascode AOLDC ≈ 88 dB (27,000 V/V). AGE ≈ 34 dB (50 V/V). AOLDC,GE = 88 + 34 = 122 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 devices have high intrinsic gain (gm*ro > 100), leading to very high overall gain when cascoded and enhanced.

dominant_pole_GE.description: The dominant low-frequency pole of the GE op-amp.

equation.explanation: The pole is formed by the enhanced output resistance and the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes Cc is the dominant capacitance at the output node.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The extremely high output resistance pushes the dominant pole to a very low frequency.

unity_gain_frequency.description: The frequency at which the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

equation.explanation: Determined by the main stage transconductance and the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes a single-pole roll-off up to the unity-gain frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact bias current and resulting gm of the input pair. The text mentions 400 MHz for their specific sizing.

actual_regulated_voltage.description: The actual output voltage when configured as a unity-gain buffer/regulator.

equation.explanation: Shows the error introduced by finite open-loop gain.
equation.assumptions: For unity gain, RA=0, RB=open, so RB/(RA+RB) = 1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The high open-loop gain ensures the closed-loop gain is extremely close to ideal 1 V/V.

min_output_voltage_saturation.description: Minimum output voltage to keep the output current source in saturation.

equation.explanation: Ensures the output transistor does not enter the triode region.
equation.assumptions: Assumes a specific output stage topology (PMOS CS with NMOS load).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical threshold and overdrive voltages for SKY130 devices.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure closed-loop bandwidth, DC accuracy, and transient step response of the unity-gain configured GE op-amp.
